description: action-guard: before every Bash, PowerShell, WebFetch or MCP tool call, decide whether the call would change the protected web application (policy: scripts/action_guard.json, overridden by ~/.claude/action-guard/config.json). Deny, ask, or stay silent. The command tries $KIT_PYTHON first (settings env; on Windows the path of a real python.exe, never a Store or PyManager alias), then python3, then py; the guard exits 0 whenever it started.

hooks.command: "${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/action_guard.py" hook || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/action_guard.py" hook || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/action_guard.py" hook || exit 1
